text: Ethics in AI is becoming a very important topic today. As artificial intelligence grows, we must think about its impact on people. One major problem is bias. AI systems can learn from data that is not fair, which may lead to unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or even medical care. Fairness means treating everyone equally, so we need to check AI carefully. Privacy is another concern, because AI often uses personal data. People should know how their information is used. Transparency matters too: we should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must work together to create rules that protect everyone.
